Market today: The 'Magnificent Seven' correlation is breaking, meaning individual tech and chip names will move more independently. While Microsoft jumped on strong cloud growth, Fortinet and ServiceNow slid, showing a mixed picture for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down over 52% and leveraged. Your other leveraged SELL positions (METU, MUU, SPAL) are also deep in the red, amplifying losses on margin. SMCI is nearing its stop.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged SELL positions for further downside. Also, watch SNOW for a potential add if it hits the scanner's entry range.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressively managing your deep losses in leveraged ETFs and being highly selective with new tech/chip plays.
plays: Your SOXL is down over 52% and leveraged. Re-evaluate your stop or consider cutting losses given the extreme drawdown.
SMCI is nearing its stop at 37.3. Be ready to exit if it breaks below to protect capital.
SNOW scanner flags a long entry at 337.76-337.1, stop 335.09. Consider adding if it pulls back to this range.
